name: LIONIND
recent: LIONIND 于 2026 年 11 月 26 日召开第 95 届常年股东大会，所有决议均获通过；同日发布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度的财报。此外，公司于 9 月 4 日就拟议出售土地签署修订契约，并于 10 月 8 日披露审计报告含与持续经营相关重大不确定性的修改意见。
notable: 第 95 届常年股东大会于 2026 年 11 月 26 日举行，所有决议均获股东通过。
公司就拟议出售土地与 Unichamp Mineral 签署修订及重述契约，以修改部分买卖协议条款。
董事会及审计委员会成员出现变动，Tan Sri Ayob Khan Bin Mydin Pitchay 卸任。
risks: 审计报告含与持续经营相关的重大不确定性修改意见。
公司于 2026 年 10 月 9 日及 11 月 26 日多次公告提供财务援助。

recent_en: LIONIND held its 95th AGM on 26 November 2026, where all resolutions were passed, and released its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 on the same day. The company also signed a deed of amendment for its proposed land disposals on 4 September and disclosed a modified audit opinion with material uncertainty related to going concern on 8 October.
notable_en: The 95th AGM was held on 26 November 2026 and all resolutions were passed by shareholders.
The company entered into a deed of amendment and restatement with Unichamp Mineral to amend certain terms of the SPAs for the proposed land disposals.
There were changes in the boardroom and audit committee, with Tan Sri Ayob Khan Bin Mydin Pitchay stepping down.
risks_en: The audit report includes a modified opinion with material uncertainty related to going concern.
The company announced the provision of financial assistance on 9 October and 26 November 2026.
